text: So, how can I help? I have such bad anxiety before exams. I can’t sleep, I feel sick, and I totally blank out when test time comes. Help! I get really anxious too. Some things that have helped me are exercising the day before to reduce stress, getting good sleep, and meditating right before the exam to calm nerves. Meditating is a great idea. Do you use any apps or recordings when you meditate? Yes! I really like the Calm app. It has short, guided meditations for relieving anxiety that I’ll listen to before a stressful exam. I’ll check that out. Also, do you have any tips for staying focused during the exam when anxiety strikes? Deep breathing has been huge for me. I’ll take a few deep breaths when I start to feel anxious which helps ground me and reduce panicking thoughts. Breathing techniques sound really useful. I’m definitely going to try meditating and deep breathing before my next exam. Hopefully it makes a difference! Great. Let me know how it goes. I will. Thanks again.
